caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular frame design, where the top and left sides are colored and the right and bottom sides are in pencil outline. The colored portion of the frame features alternating sections of rich brown, deep black, and yellow-gold, with circular yellow ornaments in each corner. The inner top section of the frame contains a landscape painting showing a rural scene with a house on the left, green grass, a path curving toward the right, scattered vegetation, and multiple trees with green and yellow foliage under a light blue sky. The right and bottom sections of the frame remain uncolored, only sketched in pencil, mirroring the structure and ornamentation of the colored portions. The background of the image is light beige, possibly from the paper, and there is faint pencil writing at the bottom of the page.
title: Mirror
